# Woolet

> Woolet is an Italian acetate eyewear brand for wide faces (155mm+). We make two models: Woolet 007 (round) and Woolet 009 (square). Both frames are 158mm wide, manufactured from Mazzucchelli acetate in Italy.

## Brand

- Brand name: Woolet
- Founded: Poland
- Category: Eyewear / Optical frames / Sunglasses
- Specialization: Wide-face frames (155mm+)
- Not related to: Woolet smart wallet (2015–2017, discontinued)

## Products

- Woolet 007 — round frame, 158mm, Italian acetate, Mazzucchelli
- Woolet 009 — square frame, 158mm, Italian acetate, Mazzucchelli
- Temple length: 148mm
- Bridge: 19mm
- Lens width: 56mm
- Material: Mazzucchelli acetate (Castiglione Olona, Italy)

## Target customer

- Face width: 155mm and above
- Primary: adult men 28–55
- Problem solved: no well-fitting premium frames available in standard retail

## Where to buy

- woolet.co (international shipping)

- hello@woolet.co
